Starting in April through June, Hanno City Hall will run a pilot program with food trucks and a market during lunch hours. Food trucks will operate almost daily, and the market will set up once a week on the main building's wood deck. Both are open to the public.

Participating food trucks include: Nazar Kebab, Assombrosso! Saitama 1st, Nakayama Tea House, Blue Tarp, Smoke Lodge Hanno no Mori, Hanno Samosa, and Curry Jutti. Market vendors include: Community House Rakusai, Lakeside Terrace Naguri Lake, Ishidaya Confectionery, and Takedera.

Reservations are requested by contacting each vendor the day before. Walk-in purchases are also welcome. Seating benches called "hashira benches" will be available on the wood deck of the main building's first floor.
summary: 📢 Kitchen cars and market stalls coming to Hanno City Hall starting in April!
